cause: The first specialist gate locally labeled MultiVI and PeakVI as peak_accessibility_rate outputs and used a generic scooby identity. The frozen observed-multiome census defines MultiVI and PeakVI as joint_representation outputs and separately registers scooby_epicardioids and scooby_neurips as functional_track outputs.
scientific_impact: The first gate cannot authorize any specialist comparison because it does not preserve the authoritative native output-family identities.
retry_policy: Issue an immutable revision bound to the frozen candidate census, retain native functional-track and joint-representation lanes, and permit comparison with observed_atac_glm only through a separately identified prediction-level common-profile projection frozen before scoring.
